query: Hi there, I just bought this phone with the official IP67 waterproof certification last month, but right now even though I need to use my apps, they aren't connecting at all—airplane mode is on, I already revoked both of the app's permissions, my data usage is over the monthly limit, I'm currently abroad and roaming is turned off, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
